Option Compare Database
Option Explicit

Public Const FILTER_ALL As Integer = -1

Public Function GetCountOfClientsByFiscalYear(FiscalYear As Integer) As Integer

    Dim distinctCount As Integer
    ' We use a subquery to get unique IDs first
    distinctCount = DBEngine(0)(0).OpenRecordset( _
        "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ClientID FROM tblClientServiceNeeds WHERE FiscalYear = " & FiscalYear & ")" _
        ).Fields(0)

    GetCountOfClientsByFiscalYear = distinctCount

End Function



Public Function GetRptClientServicePlanAndShortFallTotals(ByVal ClientID As Integer, ByVal FiscalYear As Integer) As String

    Dim result As String
    Dim TotalCost As Currency
    Dim grandTotalCost As Currency
    Dim budgetAmount As Currency
    Dim shortfall As Currency
    Dim sql As String

    sql = "SELECT FiscalYear, AnnualBudget, TotalPlannedCost, RemainingBudget FROM qryClientBudgetSummary WHERE " & _
            "ClientID=" & ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & FiscalYear

    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset(sql, dbOpenSnapshot)

    If rs.EOF Then
        TotalCost = 0
        budgetAmount = 0
        shortfall = 0
    Else
        TotalCost = rs!TotalPlannedCost
        budgetAmount = rs!AnnualBudget
        shortfall = rs!RemainingBudget
    End If

    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    

    result = Quote("Total Planned Cost") & ";" & Quote(FormatCurrency(TotalCost, 2)) & ";"
    result = result & Quote("Budget") & ";" & Quote(FormatCurrency(budgetAmount, 2)) & ";"
    result = result & Quote("Shortfall") & ";" & Quote(FormatCurrency(shortfall, 2))
    
    
    GetRptClientServicePlanAndShortFallTotals = result

End Function


Public Function Quote(stringToQuote) As String
    Quote = Chr(34) & Nz(stringToQuote, "") & Chr(34)
End Function


Public Function GetFiscalYearFromTo(ByRef sourceFY As Integer, _
                                     ByRef targetFY As Integer) As Boolean
    sourceFY = -1
    targetFY = -1
    
    If Not PromptForFiscalYear("Enter the 4-digit fiscal year to copy from", _
                               "Copy From", sourceFY) Then
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    If Not PromptForFiscalYear("Enter the 4-digit fiscal year to copy to", _
                               "Copy To", targetFY) Then
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    If sourceFY = targetFY Then
        MsgBox "Source and target fiscal years must be different.", _
               vbExclamation, "Same Fiscal Year"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    GetFiscalYearFromTo = True
End Function

Private Function PromptForFiscalYear(prompt As String, title As String, _
                                      ByRef fy As Integer) As Boolean
    Dim raw As String
    Dim i As Integer
    
    raw = InputBox(prompt, title)
    
    If Len(raw) = 0 Then
        ' User canceled or entered nothing — silent exit, no message
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    If Len(raw) <> 4 Then
        MsgBox "Please enter exactly four digits.", vbExclamation, "Invalid Year"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    For i = 1 To 4
        If Mid(raw, i, 1) < "0" Or Mid(raw, i, 1) > "9" Then
            MsgBox "Please enter only digits.", vbExclamation, "Invalid Year"
            Exit Function
        End If
    Next i
    
    fy = CInt(raw)
    
    If fy < 1900 Or fy > 2100 Then
        MsgBox "Fiscal year must be between 1900 and 2100.", vbExclamation, "Invalid Year"
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    PromptForFiscalYear = True
End Function


' Adds "(All)" to top of list
Public Function GetFilterRowSourceFromSqlSelect(sqlSelect As String) As String
    
    Dim db As DAO.Database
    Dim rs As DAO.Recordset
    Dim strSQL As String
    
    Set db = CurrentDb
    Set rs = db.OpenRecordset(sqlSelect, dbOpenDynaset)
        
    ' build the dictionary by looping through the recordset
    rs.MoveFirst
    
    Dim fldCount As Integer
    fldCount = rs.Fields.count
    Dim fldArray() As Variant
    ReDim fldArray(fldCount - 1)
        
    Dim rsArray() As String
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim j As Integer
    
    ' column headers
    For j = 0 To fldCount - 1
        fldArray(j) = rs.Fields(j).name
    Next j
    
    ReDim rsArray(0)
    rsArray(0) = Join(fldArray, ";")
        
    
    ' (All) entry
    For j = 0 To fldCount - 1
        fldArray(j) = "(All)"
    Next j
    ReDim Preserve rsArray(1)
    rsArray(1) = Join(fldArray, ";")
                
                
    ' build array of semicolon-separated strings representing records
    i = -1
    rs.MoveFirst
    Do While Not rs.EOF
        i = i + 1
        ReDim Preserve rsArray(i + 2)
        For j = 0 To fldCount - 1
            fldArray(j) = Nz(rs(j).Value, "")
        Next j
        rsArray(i + 2) = Join(fldArray, ";")
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop
    
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    Set db = Nothing
    
    ' join records with semicolons
    GetFilterRowSourceFromSqlSelect = Join(rsArray, ";")
    
End Function


' Adds "(All)" to top of list
' Bound column returns FILTER_ALL (-1) for the All option
Public Function GetFilterRowSourceFromDict(dict As Scripting.Dictionary) As String
        
    Dim rs As ADODB.Recordset
    Set rs = New ADODB.Recordset
    
    With rs
        .Fields.Append "Value", adInteger
        .Fields.Append "Caption", adVarChar, 50
        .CursorLocation = adUseClient
    End With
        
    rs.Open
        
    ' build recordset from dicitonary
    Dim k As Variant
    For Each k In dict.Keys
        With rs
            .AddNew
            .Fields("Value").Value = k
            .Fields("Caption").Value = dict(k)
            .Update
        End With
    Next
                                    
    ' add 'All' option
    With rs
        .AddNew
        .Fields("Value").Value = FILTER_ALL
        .Fields("Caption").Value = "(All)"
        .Update
    End With
                                    
    ' sort; (All) floats to top
    rs.Sort = "Value ASC"
    
    Dim rsArray() As String
    Dim i As Integer
    
    ' build array of semicolon-separated strings representing records
    i = -1
    rs.MoveFirst
    Do While Not rs.EOF
        i = i + 1
        ReDim Preserve rsArray(i)
        rsArray(i) = rs!Value & ";" & rs!Caption
        rs.MoveNext
    Loop
    
    rs.Close
    Set rs = Nothing
    
    ' join records with semicolons
    GetFilterRowSourceFromDict = Join(rsArray, ";")
    
            
End Function




' --- Tag-driven required field check ---
' Returns comma-delimited list of control names where Tag="Required" and value is empty.
' Sets TempVars!RequiredButMissing for use by embedded macros (BeforeUpdate).
' Migration stress test: RunCode + TempVars + Tag-driven metadata loop.
Public Function CheckRequiredTags(frm As Form) As String
    Dim ctl As Control
    Dim missing As String
    Dim val As Variant
    
    For Each ctl In frm.Controls
        If ctl.Tag = "Required" Then
            Select Case ctl.ControlType
                Case acTextBox, acComboBox, acListBox
                    val = ctl.Value
                    If IsNull(val) Or val = "" Then
                        If missing <> "" Then missing = missing & ", "
                        missing = missing & ctl.name
                    End If
                Case acCheckBox
                    ' "Required" on a checkbox = must be True
                    If ctl.Value <> True Then
                        If missing <> "" Then missing = missing & ", "
                        missing = missing & ctl.name
                    End If
                Case acOptionGroup
                    If IsNull(ctl.Value) Then
                        If missing <> "" Then missing = missing & ", "
                        missing = missing & ctl.name
                    End If
            End Select
        End If
    Next ctl
    
    TempVars!RequiredButMissing = missing
    CheckRequiredTags = missing
End Function

Public Function SqlQuote(v As Variant, _
                          Optional pre As Variant, _
                          Optional post As Variant) As String
    ' Wraps a value in single quotes, doubling embedded apostrophes.
    ' If pre or post is supplied, treats this as a LIKE expression:
    '   - escapes LIKE metacharacters (* ? [ #) in the value
    '   - inserts pre/post wildcards inside the quotes
    Dim s As String
    s = Replace(Nz(v, ""), "'", "''")

    Dim isLike As Boolean
    isLike = (Not IsMissing(pre)) Or (Not IsMissing(post))

    If isLike Then s = EscapeLike(s)

    Dim preStr As String, postStr As String
    If Not IsMissing(pre) Then preStr = CStr(pre)
    If Not IsMissing(post) Then postStr = CStr(post)

    SqlQuote = "'" & preStr & s & postStr & "'"
End Function

Public Function EscapeLike(ByVal s As String) As String
    Dim out As String, i As Long, ch As String
    For i = 1 To Len(s)
        ch = Mid$(s, i, 1)
        If InStr("*?[#", ch) > 0 Then
            out = out & "[" & ch & "]"
        Else
            out = out & ch
        End If
    Next i
    EscapeLike = out
End Function

Public Function whereClause(where() As String) As String
    Dim filtered() As String
    Dim i As Long
    Dim n As Long
    Dim hasAny As Boolean
    
    ' Detect if the array was ever ReDim'd (uninitialized dynamic arrays can't be read)
    On Error Resume Next
    n = UBound(where) - LBound(where) + 1
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function    ' uninitialized array — return ""
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    
    ReDim filtered(0 To n - 1)
    Dim count As Long
    count = 0
    For i = LBound(where) To UBound(where)
        If Len(where(i)) > 0 Then
            filtered(count) = where(i)
            count = count + 1
            hasAny = True
        End If
    Next i
    
    If Not hasAny Then Exit Function
    
    ReDim Preserve filtered(0 To count - 1)
    whereClause = " WHERE (" & Join(filtered, ") AND (") & ") "
End Function

Public Function TestWhereClause() As String
    Dim clauses As New Collection
    clauses.Add "id = 100"
    clauses.Add "name = 'Jim'"
    TestWhereClause = whereClauseFromCollection(clauses)
End Function

Public Function whereClauseFromCollection(clauses As Collection) As String
    If clauses.count = 0 Then Exit Function
    Dim arr() As String
    ReDim arr(0 To clauses.count - 1)
    Dim i As Long
    For i = 1 To clauses.count
        arr(i - 1) = clauses(i)
    Next i
    whereClauseFromCollection = " WHERE (" & Join(arr, ") AND (") & ") "
End Function



' --- Age calculation (used in qryClientAge) ---
Public Function CalcAge(DateOfBirth As Variant) As Variant
    If IsNull(DateOfBirth) Then
        CalcAge = Null
        Exit Function
    End If
    If Not IsDate(DateOfBirth) Then
        CalcAge = Null
        Exit Function
    End If
    If DateOfBirth > Date Then
        CalcAge = Null
        Exit Function
    End If
    
    Dim age As Long
    age = Year(Date) - Year(DateOfBirth)
    If DateSerial(Year(Date), Month(DateOfBirth), Day(DateOfBirth)) > Date Then
        age = age - 1
    End If
    CalcAge = age
End Function

' --- Budget utilization (used in qryBudgetUtilization) ---
Public Function GetBudgetUtilizationPct(ClientID As Long, FiscalYear As Integer) As Variant
    Dim budget As Currency
    Dim planned As Currency

    budget = Nz(DLookup("AnnualBudget", "tblClientBudgets", _
                        "ClientID=" & ClientID & " AND FiscalYear=" & FiscalYear), 0)
    If budget = 0 Then
        GetBudgetUtilizationPct = Null
        Exit Function
    End If

    planned = Nz(DSum("AnnualEstCost", "tblClientServicePlan", _
                      "FiscalYear=" & FiscalYear & _
                      " AND ClientServiceNeedID IN (SELECT ClientServiceNeedID FROM tblClientServiceNeeds WHERE ClientID=" & ClientID & ")"), 0)

    GetBudgetUtilizationPct = Round((planned / budget) * 100, 1)
End Function

' --- Current fiscal year helper (used in crosstab queries) ---
Public Function GetCurrentFiscalYear() As Integer
    Dim result As Variant
    result = DLookup("FiscalYear", "tlkpFiscalYears", "IsCurrent = True")
    If IsNull(result) Then
        ' Fallback: assume July-June FY; if current month >= July, FY = next calendar year
        If Month(Date) >= 7 Then
            GetCurrentFiscalYear = Year(Date) + 1
        Else
            GetCurrentFiscalYear = Year(Date)
        End If
    Else
        GetCurrentFiscalYear = CInt(result)
    End If
End Function

' --- Format phone number ---
Public Function FormatPhone(PhoneRaw As Variant) As String
    If IsNull(PhoneRaw) Then FormatPhone = "": Exit Function
    Dim digits As String
    Dim i As Integer
    For i = 1 To Len(PhoneRaw)
        If IsNumeric(Mid(PhoneRaw, i, 1)) Then digits = digits & Mid(PhoneRaw, i, 1)
    Next i
    If Len(digits) = 10 Then
        FormatPhone = "(" & Left(digits, 3) & ") " & Mid(digits, 4, 3) & "-" & Right(digits, 4)
    Else
        FormatPhone = CStr(PhoneRaw)
    End If
End Function

' --- Weeks between two dates ---
Public Function WeeksBetween(StartDate As Date, EndDate As Date) As Double
    WeeksBetween = DateDiff("d", StartDate, EndDate) / 7
End Function
